HVAC/radio occupy the fascia below the centre vent; the tunnel console is a separate sloped piece.

documentary_sources.author: 912Flyer
documentary_sources.specimen: Owner-described 1994 RHD 993; M564 not verified and not the target LHD specimen
documentary_sources.provenance: Public owner restoration post, previously inspected in this research session; local PorscheFanatics measurement extraction provides tool-size cross-references. The page also includes borrowed images.
documentary_sources.licence: No image reuse licence identified; link and own factual summary only
observations: The upper pad and separate front defroster grille are removable pieces.
The author reports two clips at the top of the centre vent and a nut accessible behind it.
The grille, end pieces and central vent conceal different attachment locations.
documentary_sources.geometry_use: Qualitative separation of pad, grille and vent only; no attachment coordinates or fastener geometry

documentary_sources.author: 912Flyer
documentary_sources.specimen: Owner-described RHD 1994 993; driver airbag discussed, not evidence for M564 LHD
documentary_sources.provenance: Public owner restoration post and corresponding local PorscheFanatics extraction; some images are credited to other sites.
documentary_sources.licence: No image reuse licence identified; link and own factual summary only
observations: Four lower-dashboard studs are described: outer pair behind side vents, inner pair beside the radio and HVAC.
Each side vent is described as retained by four metal clips.
The 8 mm and 10 mm values describe tools, not hole diameters, pitch or bolt threads.
documentary_sources.geometry_use: Lower fascia/side-vent/central-control relationships; attachment inventory remains a candidate for the exact-specimen contract, not a measured assembly

modelling_decisions: Use original parametric display geometry for the pad and hood instead of retaining legacy circular vent holes beneath masks.
Use five individual gauge faces and stylized marks; dial angles and marks do not represent instrument readings or calibrated scales.
Use linked photographs to guide rounded forms, panel segmentation and visible control relationships; every coordinate remains an artistic assumption.
Keep assembly transforms, attachment geometry and independent interface contract values null. DDK RHD hardware is not mirrored into invented LHD mounting coordinates.
